note: The 100+ finding target was deliberately not met. This repository has already been through multiple stabilization passes (audit-reports/archive, docs/RELAY_*). Only findings with reproducible code or live-DB evidence are listed. Hypotheses that could not be executed are listed under notRun, not counted as confirmed. Closure pass: R-02/R-03/R-08/R-09/R-10/R-11/R-12/R-13/R-14/R-15 fixed; R-07 remains accepted/open.

findings.title: Cross-organization seat write through Work Setup operators/backups
findings.rootCause: saveWorkSetup validated only primaryRepId against organization membership; operator/backup ids were passed unchecked to configureCoverageStatement, and the pc_insert/ia_insert RLS policies check the row organization_id but not that rep_id belongs to that organization.
findings.evidence: src/lib/operations/work-setup-write.ts:103-111 (only primary checked); src/lib/coverage/configure.ts:117-135 (inserts arbitrary rep ids); supabase/migrations/20261106120000_operations_autopilot.sql:144-146 (pc_insert); 20261101160000_close_anon_exposure.sql:144-146 (ia_insert)
findings.impact: An authenticated admin/manager could write a rep from another organization into profile_coverage and identity_assignments, polluting the target population and arming notifications for a foreign rep.
findings.fix: Added assertSeatsInOrg() and called it from configureCoverage() and assignBackupResponsibility().

findings.title: Work Setup allocation replace could leave a lane with zero active allocations
findings.rootCause: dpa_active_uniq is a partial unique index on (plan_id, rep_id) WHERE active, so the writer deactivated every active share before inserting the new set. A failure between the two statements lost the allocations.
findings.impact: A transient DB error during a routine target edit could silently drop every operator's allocation on a lane, changing assigned/unallocated totals.
findings.fix: Extracted replacePlanAllocations(): update existing shares in place, insert new ones, then deactivate removed ones in one statement.
findings.regressionTest: tests/work-setup-hardening.test.ts (existing share survives a failed insert)
findings.remaining: The whole saveWorkSetup is still not one SQL transaction; see R-13.

findings.title: Local live-test configuration targets the production database
findings.rootCause: .env.local sets DATABASE_URL/SERVICE_DATABASE_URL to the Aiven relay_prod_final database; vitest.live.config.mts loads .env.local and its LIVE_TEST_FILES include write-heavy suites.
findings.evidence: .env.local DATABASE_URL host pg-393a7079-...aivencloud.com/relay_prod_final; vitest.live.config.mts:9; tests/operator-visibility.live.test.ts (26 insert/update/delete calls); tests/v6-live-coverage-acceptance.test.ts (15)
findings.impact: Running `npm run test:live` mutates production. `npm test` also reads production in tests/accountability-service.test.ts (read-only).
findings.remediation: Point live tests at the isolated relay_staging clone (OPS.md §staging) and add a guard that refuses to run live suites when the URL matches the production database name.
findings.notRun: The live suite was deliberately NOT executed in this pass because it writes to production.

findings.title: Organization deletion did not explicitly revoke sessions
findings.rootCause: The route deleted Better Auth users but never called signOutUser; it relied on provider cascade behaviour.
findings.regressionTest: none (provider admin call; verified by typecheck and unit suite)

findings.title: Login `next` sanitizer allowed a backslash protocol-relative redirect
findings.rootCause: sanitizeNextPath rejected only values not starting with '/' and values starting with '//'; browsers fold a backslash to a slash for special URLs.
findings.fix: Reject values containing backslash or whitespace.
findings.regressionTest: none (pure function; covered by tsc and unit suite)

findings.title: GitHub personal access token embedded in the local git remote URL
findings.evidence: git config --get remote.origin.url contained a 40-char ghp_ token in the userinfo (not a tracked file)
findings.fix: Remote URL replaced with https://github.com/aneebiqbal/bpule.relay.git; the token was not printed or persisted.
findings.remaining: The token must be revoked/rotated in GitHub by the owner; pushes now need a credential helper or SSH.

findings.title: Two coexisting AI routing systems
findings.evidence: src/lib/ai/routing.ts (legacy, dated 2026-10-09) is still imported by src/lib/ai/draft-stream.ts, src/lib/ai/draft.ts, src/lib/ai/provider.ts and src/lib/content/intelligence/forge.ts, while src/lib/ai/runtime/* is the canonical router.
findings.impact: Provider selection can diverge depending on entry point; twice the prompt/model configuration to keep in sync.

findings.title: UTC dates in adjacent target/notification surfaces
findings.impact: For a non-UTC organization these surfaces can read or write the wrong business day even though the canonical projection is org-date correct.

findings.title: personal = assigned - unseatedAllocationUnits breaks for a solo-seat lane that carries an allocation
findings.evidence: src/lib/execution/accountability.ts:307-308 counts the full lane target in assigned when seats.length === 1, while lanePersonalTarget:251-252 returns the allocation; unseatedAllocationUnits is 0.
findings.impact: reconcilePopulations.personal can disagree with assigned - unseatedAllocationUnits. Reachable through the admin allocations API.

findings.title: Work Setup cannot clear allocations
findings.evidence: src/lib/operations/work-setup-write.ts:180-194: allocations: [] produces an empty byActivity map, so the replace loop never runs.
findings.impact: An admin who removes every allocation in the UI silently keeps the previous shares.

findings.title: Work Setup permits allocations to unseated reps
findings.evidence: src/lib/operations/work-setup-write.ts:186 checks only organization membership, not lane seats; the read model flags the result as allocation-without-seat drift (src/lib/operations/work-setup.ts:149-152).
findings.impact: Manufactures unseatedAllocationUnits and confuses rep expectations.

findings.title: Dead _userId parameters in workspace authorization helpers
findings.evidence: src/lib/auth/workspace.ts:111,127 accept _userId and never use it; authorization is session-based.
findings.impact: False sense of per-user auth; no runtime exposure.

findings.title: No multi-statement transaction and no optimistic concurrency on Work Setup
findings.evidence: DbClient exposes only from/rpc/raw (src/lib/db/types.ts:104-115); each query is its own transaction (src/lib/db/postgres.ts:150-188). saveWorkSetup commits seats, targets and allocations independently (src/lib/operations/work-setup-write.ts:115-231). No revision/If-Match guard exists.
findings.impact: Two concurrent admins last-writer-wins; a failure after the seat write but before targets leaves a half-applied change.
findings.remediation: Add a transaction primitive to DbClient/PostgresExecutorImpl (and Neon), wrap saveWorkSetup and configureCoverageStatement, and add a revision check.

findings.title: backfillProfileCoverage is a second coverage writer
findings.evidence: src/lib/profiles/canonical.ts:493-519 mutates profile_coverage directly without eligibility, acknowledgement or audit sync; no callers found.
findings.impact: Contradicts the single-writer claim; dead today but a trap for the next change.

findings.title: The stated requirement invariant is not the implemented one
findings.evidence: Task/contract phrasing says requirement = assigned + unallocated; the code implements requirement = requirementAssigned + requirementUnallocated and assigned + unallocated = tracked (src/lib/execution/accountability.ts:451-454, 481-495).
findings.impact: A consumer asserting the wrong equation will report a false mismatch whenever non-targetable lanes exist.
